name: Zedland (fictional test jurisdiction)

rules.summary: A provider may not bill the survivor for a forensic exam.
rules.quote: A health care provider shall not bill a victim for any part of a sexual assault forensic examination.

rules.summary: The exam fund pays the provider directly.
rules.quote: The Forensic Exam Fund shall pay the provider directly for the examination.

rules.summary: Total award limit of $25,000.
rules.quote: The total award for a claim shall not exceed $25,000.

rules.summary: Catastrophic injury awards up to $40,000.
rules.quote: An award that includes catastrophic injury costs shall not exceed $40,000.

rules.summary: Medical expenses are covered.
rules.quote: Reasonable medical and hospital expenses are compensable.

rules.summary: Counseling is covered.
rules.quote: Mental health counseling for the victim is compensable.

rules.summary: Counseling is paid at up to $90 per session for 3 sessions.
rules.quote: Counseling shall be paid at no more than $90 per session, for no more than 3 sessions.

rules.summary: Counseling is limited to $3,000 per claim.
rules.quote: Counseling payments shall not exceed $3,000 per claim.

rules.summary: Counseling by an unlicensed counselor is paid at up to $60 per session.
rules.quote: Counseling by an unlicensed counselor shall be paid at no more than $60 per session.

rules.summary: Family members may receive up to $500 in counseling.
rules.quote: Family members of a victim may receive up to $500 in counseling.

rules.summary: Lost wages are covered.
rules.quote: Loss of earnings resulting from the crime is compensable.

rules.summary: Lost wages up to $600 per week.
rules.quote: Lost wages shall not exceed $600 per week.

rules.summary: Travel to treatment at $0.50 per mile.
rules.quote: Travel to treatment is reimbursed at $0.50 per mile.

rules.summary: Relocation up to $2,000.
rules.quote: Relocation expenses shall not exceed $2,000.

rules.summary: Security devices up to $400 per residence.
rules.quote: Security devices shall not exceed $400 per residence.

rules.summary: Dental care is limited to 10 visits.
rules.quote: Dental care is limited to 10 visits.

rules.summary: Dental care is covered.
rules.quote: Dental care needed because of the crime is compensable.

params.item: a lost or stolen cell phone or wallet

rules.summary: A lost or stolen phone or wallet is not covered.
rules.quote: Replacement of a lost or stolen cell phone or wallet is not compensable.

rules.summary: Property held as evidence up to $500.
rules.quote: Property held as evidence may be replaced up to $500.

rules.summary: Pain and suffering is not covered.
rules.quote: Pain and suffering is not compensable.

rules.summary: Tuition is not covered.
rules.quote: Tuition and school fees are not compensable.

rules.summary: File within 3 years of the crime.
rules.quote: A claim shall be filed within 3 years after the crime.

rules.summary: Or within 400 days of discovery.
rules.quote: A claim may be filed within 400 days after discovery of the crime.

rules.summary: The board may extend the deadline for good cause.
rules.quote: The board may extend the filing period for good cause.

rules.summary: Report within 5 days, unless the survivor had a forensic exam.
rules.quote: The crime shall be reported to law enforcement within 5 days, except that a victim of sexual assault who receives a forensic examination need not report.

rules.summary: Minimum loss of $100, which does not apply to sexual assault.
rules.quote: A claimant shall have a minimum loss of $100; this requirement does not apply to a victim of sexual assault.

rules.summary: Insurance payments reduce the award.
rules.quote: An award shall be reduced by any amount paid by insurance or another collateral source.

rules.summary: The board may reduce an award for contributory conduct.
rules.quote: The board may reduce an award for the victim's contributory conduct.

rules.summary: Emergency awards up to $500.
rules.quote: The board may grant an emergency award of up to $500.

rules.summary: Sexual assault is a covered crime.
rules.quote: Sexual assault is a compensable crime.

rules.summary: Anyone harmed by a crime in Zedland may apply.
rules.quote: A victim of a crime committed in Zedland may apply regardless of residence.

params.target: Victim Services Board, 1 Example Way, Zedland

rules.summary: Applications can be mailed to the board.
rules.quote: Mail the completed application to the Victim Services Board, 1 Example Way, Zedland.

rules.summary: Prescriptions are covered.
rules.quote: Prescription medication is compensable.

rules.summary: Child care during treatment is covered.
rules.quote: Child care needed so the victim can attend treatment is compensable.

coverage.notes: Synthetic fixture for engine tests. Not a real jurisdiction; every quote is invented.

researcher_notes: Fictional. Built so each engine semantic step has at least one rule to exercise it.
